title: Chorizo & Chicken Pasta
description: Verified ingredients, general method. Amounts are from Cookidoo AU; the official steps are subscription-gated.

confidence.note: Verified ingredients, general method. Amounts are from Cookidoo AU; the official steps are subscription-gated.

methodLabel: General method (not the official Cookidoo steps)

steps.text: Chop the onion (150g), garlic ({{garlic}} cloves) and chilli ({{chilli}}) 3 sec / Speed 5. Scrape down.
Add the olive oil ({{oil}}) and sauté 3 min / 120°C / Speed 1.
Add the chorizo ({{chorizo}}) and sauté 3 min / 120°C / Reverse / Speed 1 to render some fat and flavour the base.
Add the capsicum (90g), carrot (160g) and zucchini ({{zucchini}}). Chop 4 sec / Speed 5.

Add the tomato paste ({{tomato-paste}}), diced tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}), salt ({{salt}}) and pepper ({{pepper}}). Add the chicken ({{chicken}}) and pasta ({{pasta}}) with enough water to cover the pasta.
Cook 18–20 min / 100°C / Reverse / Speed 1, until the pasta is tender and the chicken cooked through. Rest a few minutes before serving.
